chapterInfo.content:
15
Odwan a wayera no
(Mateo 18.12-14)
1Na togyefoɔ ne nnebɔneyɛfoɔ no nyinaa twi bɛnee no sɛ wɔrebɛtie no. 2#Luk 5.30 Na Farisifoɔ ne Atwerɛfoɔ no nwiinwii kaa sɛ: Oyi gye nnebɔneyɛfoɔ, na ɔne wɔn didi. 3Enti ɔbuu wɔn bɛ yi sɛ:
4 # Hes 34.11; 34.16; Luk 19.10 Mo mu nipa bɛn na sɛ ɔwɔ nnwanten ɔha na wɔn mu baako kɔyera a, ɔrennya aduɔkron nkron no ɛserɛ soɔ, na ɔnni deɛ wayera no akyi nkɔsi sɛ ɔbɛhu no? 5Na sɛ ɔhu no a, ɔde no bɔ ne kɔn ho, na n’ani gye. 6Na ɔba fie a, ɔfrɛfrɛ ne nnamfo ne n’afipamfoɔ boa ano ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Mo ne me ani nnye, ɛfiri sɛ mahunu me dwan a ɔyeraeɛ no. 7Mese mo sɛ: Saa ara na anigyeɛ bɛba soro, ɔdebɔneyɛni baako a ɔsakyera n’adwene ho, sene nnipa tenenee aduɔkron nkron a ɛnhia wɔn adwensakyera.
Dwetɛbena a ayera no
8 Anaasɛ ɔbaa bɛn na ɔwɔ nnwetɛbena du, na emu baako yera a, ɔrensɔ kanea, na ɔmpra ɛdan no mu, na ɔnhwehwɛ yie nkɔsi sɛ ɔbɛhunu? 9Na ɔhunu a, ɔfrɛfrɛ ne nnamfo ne n’afipamfoɔ boa ano, na ɔka sɛ: Mo ne me ani nnye, ɛfiri sɛ mahunu me dwetɛbena a ɛyeraeɛ no. 10#Efe 3.10 Saa ara na mese mo sɛ: Anigyeɛ ba Nyankopɔn abɔfoɔ anim ɔdebɔneyɛni baako a ɔsakyera n’adwene ho.
Ɔba hohwini
11 Na ɔse: Onipa bi wɔ mmammarima baanu. 12Na wɔn mu akumaa no ka kyerɛɛ n’agya sɛ: Agya, fa ahodeɛ a ɛbɛyɛ me dea no ma me! Na ɔkyɛɛ n’asetenadeɛ mu maa wɔn. 13#Mmb 29.3 Na anni da bi na ɔba kumaa no boaboaa ne nyinaa ano, na ɔtuu kwan kɔɔ akyirikyiri asase bi soɔ; ɛhɔ na ɔkɔbɔɔ ahohwie sɛee n’ahodeɛ nyinaa. 14Na ɔhweree ne nyinaa wieeɛ no, ɛkɔm kɛseɛ bi baa asase no so, na ɛfirii aseɛ hiaa no. 15Na ɔde ne ho kɔdanee asase no so hɔni bi; na ɔmaa no kɔɔ ne mfuo mu kɔhwɛɛ mprako. 16#Mmb 23.21 Na ne kɔn dɔɔ sɛ ɔde asɛhono a mprako no die no bi hyɛ n’afuru ma; nanso obiara amma no. 17Na n’ani baa ne ho soɔ no, ɔkaa sɛ: Apaafoɔ ahe na m’agya nnie a wɔnnya aduane ma no mmoro soɔ; na me deɛ, ɛkɔm rekum me yi? 18#Yer 3.12-13; Dwom 51.4 Mɛsɔre makɔ m’agya nkyɛn, na mase no sɛ: Agya, mayɛ ɔsoro ne w’anim bɔne, 19na memfata sɛ wɔfrɛ me wo ba bio, na yɛ me sɛ w’apaafoɔ no mu baako!
20 Na ɔsɔre baa n’agya nkyɛn. Na ɔda so wɔ akyirikyiri no, n’agya hunuu no, na ne yam hyehyee no, na ɔtutuu mmirika kɔyɛɛ no atuu, na ɔfee n’ano. 21Na ɔba no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Agya, mayɛ ɔsoro ne w’anim bɔne, na memfata sɛ wɔfrɛ me wo ba bio. 22Ɛnna agya no ka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa sɛ: Momfa atadeɛ a ɛyɛ no mmra mmɛhyɛ no, na momfa pɛtea nhyɛ ne nsa ne mpaboa nhyɛ ne nan; 23na momfa nantwie ba a wadɔre sradeɛ no mmra mmɛkum no, na yɛnni, na yɛn ani nnye, 24#Efe 2.1; 2.5; 5.14 ɛfiri sɛ, me ba yi wui, na wanyane bio; ɔyerae, na wɔahu no. Na wɔfirii aseɛ gyee wɔn ani.
25 Na ne ba panin no wɔ afuom; na ɔreba na ɔbɛn fie no, ɔtee sankuo ne asa. 26Na ɔfrɛɛ asomfoɔ no mu baako bisaa no asɛm ko a asie. 27Na ɔsee no sɛ: Wo nua aba, na w’agya akum nantwie ba a wadɔre sradeɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ ne nsa aka no nkwahosan mu. 28#Luk 15.2 Na ne bo fui, na wampɛ sɛ ɔkɔ mu. Ɛnna n’agya firii adi bɛkorɔkorɔɔ no. 29Na ɔbua see agya no sɛ: Hwɛ mfirinhyia dodoɔ yi a mede masom woɔ, nso mentoo wo mmara da; nanso wommaa me abirekyie ba bi sɛ me ne me nnamfonom mfa nkɔgye yɛn ani da. 30Na wo ba yi a ɔne nnwamamfoɔ adi w’ahodeɛ no baeɛ ara pɛ deɛ, woakum nantwie ba a wadɔre sradeɛ no ama no. 31Na ɔsee no sɛ: Ɔba, wowɔ me nkyɛn daa, na deɛ mewɔ nyinaa yɛ wo dea. 32Na ɛsɛ sɛ yɛn ani gyeɛ na yɛn bo tɔ yɛn yam, ɛfiri sɛ wo nua yi wui, na wanyane; ɔyerae, na wɔahu no.

Na togyefoɔ ne nnebɔneyɛfoɔ no nyinaa twi bɛnee no sɛ wɔrebɛtie no. Na Farisifoɔ ne Atwerɛfoɔ no nwiinwii kaa sɛ: Oyi gye nnebɔneyɛfoɔ, na ɔne wɔn didi. Enti ɔbuu wɔn bɛ yi sɛ:
Mo mu nipa bɛn na sɛ ɔwɔ nnwanten ɔha na wɔn mu baako kɔyera a, ɔrennya aduɔkron nkron no ɛserɛ soɔ, na ɔnni deɛ wayera no akyi nkɔsi sɛ ɔbɛhu no? Na sɛ ɔhu no a, ɔde no bɔ ne kɔn ho, na n’ani gye. Na ɔba fie a, ɔfrɛfrɛ ne nnamfo ne n’afipamfoɔ boa ano ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Mo ne me ani nnye, ɛfiri sɛ mahunu me dwan a ɔyeraeɛ no. Mese mo sɛ: Saa ara na anigyeɛ bɛba soro, ɔdebɔneyɛni baako a ɔsakyera n’adwene ho, sene nnipa tenenee aduɔkron nkron a ɛnhia wɔn adwensakyera.

Anaasɛ ɔbaa bɛn na ɔwɔ nnwetɛbena du, na emu baako yera a, ɔrensɔ kanea, na ɔmpra ɛdan no mu, na ɔnhwehwɛ yie nkɔsi sɛ ɔbɛhunu? Na ɔhunu a, ɔfrɛfrɛ ne nnamfo ne n’afipamfoɔ boa ano, na ɔka sɛ: Mo ne me ani nnye, ɛfiri sɛ mahunu me dwetɛbena a ɛyeraeɛ no. Saa ara na mese mo sɛ: Anigyeɛ ba Nyankopɔn abɔfoɔ anim ɔdebɔneyɛni baako a ɔsakyera n’adwene ho.

Na ɔse: Onipa bi wɔ mmammarima baanu. Na wɔn mu akumaa no ka kyerɛɛ n’agya sɛ: Agya, fa ahodeɛ a ɛbɛyɛ me dea no ma me! Na ɔkyɛɛ n’asetenadeɛ mu maa wɔn. Na anni da bi na ɔba kumaa no boaboaa ne nyinaa ano, na ɔtuu kwan kɔɔ akyirikyiri asase bi soɔ; ɛhɔ na ɔkɔbɔɔ ahohwie sɛee n’ahodeɛ nyinaa. Na ɔhweree ne nyinaa wieeɛ no, ɛkɔm kɛseɛ bi baa asase no so, na ɛfirii aseɛ hiaa no. Na ɔde ne ho kɔdanee asase no so hɔni bi; na ɔmaa no kɔɔ ne mfuo mu kɔhwɛɛ mprako. Na ne kɔn dɔɔ sɛ ɔde asɛhono a mprako no die no bi hyɛ n’afuru ma; nanso obiara amma no. Na n’ani baa ne ho soɔ no, ɔkaa sɛ: Apaafoɔ ahe na m’agya nnie a wɔnnya aduane ma no mmoro soɔ; na me deɛ, ɛkɔm rekum me yi? Mɛsɔre makɔ m’agya nkyɛn, na mase no sɛ: Agya, mayɛ ɔsoro ne w’anim bɔne, na memfata sɛ wɔfrɛ me wo ba bio, na yɛ me sɛ w’apaafoɔ no mu baako!
Na ɔsɔre baa n’agya nkyɛn. Na ɔda so wɔ akyirikyiri no, n’agya hunuu no, na ne yam hyehyee no, na ɔtutuu mmirika kɔyɛɛ no atuu, na ɔfee n’ano. Na ɔba no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Agya, mayɛ ɔsoro ne w’anim bɔne, na memfata sɛ wɔfrɛ me wo ba bio. Ɛnna agya no ka kyerɛɛ ne nkoa sɛ: Momfa atadeɛ a ɛyɛ no mmra mmɛhyɛ no, na momfa pɛtea nhyɛ ne nsa ne mpaboa nhyɛ ne nan; na momfa nantwie ba a wadɔre sradeɛ no mmra mmɛkum no, na yɛnni, na yɛn ani nnye, ɛfiri sɛ, me ba yi wui, na wanyane bio; ɔyerae, na wɔahu no. Na wɔfirii aseɛ gyee wɔn ani.
Na ne ba panin no wɔ afuom; na ɔreba na ɔbɛn fie no, ɔtee sankuo ne asa. Na ɔfrɛɛ asomfoɔ no mu baako bisaa no asɛm ko a asie. Na ɔsee no sɛ: Wo nua aba, na w’agya akum nantwie ba a wadɔre sradeɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ ne nsa aka no nkwahosan mu. Na ne bo fui, na wampɛ sɛ ɔkɔ mu. Ɛnna n’agya firii adi bɛkorɔkorɔɔ no. Na ɔbua see agya no sɛ: Hwɛ mfirinhyia dodoɔ yi a mede masom woɔ, nso mentoo wo mmara da; nanso wommaa me abirekyie ba bi sɛ me ne me nnamfonom mfa nkɔgye yɛn ani da. Na wo ba yi a ɔne nnwamamfoɔ adi w’ahodeɛ no baeɛ ara pɛ deɛ, woakum nantwie ba a wadɔre sradeɛ no ama no. Na ɔsee no sɛ: Ɔba, wowɔ me nkyɛn daa, na deɛ mewɔ nyinaa yɛ wo dea. Na ɛsɛ sɛ yɛn ani gyeɛ na yɛn bo tɔ yɛn yam, ɛfiri sɛ wo nua yi wui, na wanyane; ɔyerae, na wɔahu no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
